criteria.criterion: At least one deterministic closure progresses without a provider call and passes the fixed oracle.
criteria.explanation: deterministic_unique_close selected closed_deterministic / analytical_unique_mapping with skip_provider=true, provider_authorized=false, and kernel provider_hook_count=0. assert_provider_dispatch_allowed raised PermissionError. AnalyticalCloseExecutor mutated pkg/core.py (reason analytical_close_applied) and the frozen pytest oracle passed independently of the candidate closes_claim flag (kernel receipt baguqeera55f45ouzpa6cxxxq2caicbyt6x4nt6ihme2focw4qhtzqgtg4hzq). closes_claim_untrusted kept the same kernel disposition without applying a fix; the oracle failed and useful_progress stayed false.

criteria.criterion: Each invalid pair fails for the expected binding/authority reason; missing capabilities stay unavailable.
criteria.explanation: Minimally altered residual pairs failed closed without provider authorization: missing receipts, mismatched task, mismatched forest, mismatched plan/doctor/obligation views, forged receipt identity, and the thin evaluate_provider_gate helper that omits view CIDs all returned missing_typed_resolvable_authority_receipts; a missing packet abstained with no_analytical_close; two closing candidates abstained with ambiguous_repair_candidates; authorization_deny_task_scope returned task_scope_mismatch. Missing planner/doctor backends deferred with missing_required_backend and capability_available=false. The sealed profile has no production model identity (production_llm_unavailable). An authorized residual whose nomination escaped the write lease was recorded as unknown_provider_effect and independently failed the oracle rather than succeeding.

criteria.criterion: No workflow-level savings are inferred from zero hooks inside the kernel, and deny-all cannot pass useful-progress criteria.
criteria.explanation: Every kernel evaluation recorded provider_hook_count=0 because PreImplementationKernel never calls a model; every receipt sets workflow_savings_inferred=false and kernel_provider_hook_count_is_not_workflow_savings=true. Residual invocations are counted only at ResidualProviderInvocation.invoke. deny_all_control skipped the provider, applied no repair, failed the frozen oracle, and kept useful_progress=false / deny_all_useful_progress=false, so a reject-everything route cannot satisfy useful-progress criteria.
